name: agent-stalled-runs-1
description: Agent runs that never settle by themselves: a launch on the record with no session is waited on for the silent window and then retried as dead; a run past its deadline is stopped once and, its session outliving the order, judged dead; a usage limit outranks the deadline and is waited out, its reset recorded; a limit with no reset time parks for a person. Tick 1.
